--- title: 'The scramble for .ai domain names' author: '{{< var author >}}' date: '2024-09-24' categories: [visualization] --- Before ChatGPT came out, AI was a joke. No one paid attention to it. In fact, the majority of people thought virtual reality (VR) was going to happen sooner. Remember the metaverse? But on November 30, 2022, the image of AI changed forever. That's because OpenAI released a product called ChatGPT. The massive success of ChatGPT led to the proliferation of AI companies, causing a surge in the purchase of `.ai` domain names.
